data.long_description:
Experience upscale waterfront living in the heart of Dubai Marina with this beautifully furnished 3-bedroom apartment in the iconic Princess Tower. Offering spacious interiors, elegant finishes, and breathtaking marina and sea views, this residence combines comfort, luxury, and convenience in one of Dubai’s most vibrant lifestyle destinations.

Property Details:

Tower: Princess Tower
Location: Dubai Marina
Type: Furnished Apartment
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 4
Spacious open-plan living and dining area
Fully furnished with modern interiors
Floor-to-ceiling windows with natural light
Contemporary fitted kitchen with premium appliances
En-suite bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
Balcony with marina and skyline views
Dedicated parking space

Property Amenities:

Indoor and outdoor swimming pools
Fully equipped gymnasium
Sauna and steam rooms
Children’s play area
High-speed elevators
24-hour security and concierge services
Covered parking
Residents’ lounge and recreational facilities
Basketball and table tennis facilities
Direct access to retail and dining destinations nearby

Location Highlights:

Prime location in Dubai Marina
Walking distance to Marina Walk
Close to JBR Beach and Bluewaters Island
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai Tram
Minutes from Dubai Marina Mall
Surrounded by cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, and entertainment venues
data.title: 3 bedroom apartment to rent
